SOCIAL STUDIES — TERMLY EXAM #4
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Self- Improvement is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Self- Improvement with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Self- Improvement never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Self- Improvement.
   D. Treat Self- Improvement as rumours only.

2. Which statement about Scientific Theory about Human Origin is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Scientific Theory about Human Origin with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Scientific Theory about Human Origin.
   C. Say Scientific Theory about Human Origin never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Scientific Theory about Human Origin as rumours only.

3. Which statement about Vegetation in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Vegetation in Africa.
   B. Treat Vegetation in Africa as rumours only.
   C. Say Vegetation in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Vegetation in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

4. Which statement about Self- Esteem Assessment is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Self- Esteem Assessment as rumours only.
   B. Say Self- Esteem Assessment never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Self- Esteem Assessment.
   D. Explain Self- Esteem Assessment with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

5. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Destroying road signs
   B. Littering in markets
   C. Avoiding all community work
   D. Obeying laws and caring for public property

6. Which statement about Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration.
   C. Explain Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration never happens in Kenya.

7. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Kisumu
   B. Nairobi
   C. Mombasa
   D. Nakuru

8. Which statement about Trans Saharan Slave Trade is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Trans Saharan Slave Trade.
   B. Say Trans Saharan Slave Trade never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Trans Saharan Slave Trade as rumours only.
   D. Explain Trans Saharan Slave Trade with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

9. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Plan income and spending wisely
   B. Ignore prices in shops
   C. Avoid saving forever
   D. Hide all money underground

10. Which statement about Population Growth in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Population Growth in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Population Growth in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Population Growth in Africa.
   D. Treat Population Growth in Africa as rumours only.

11. Which statement about Historical Sites and Monuments in Africa ● Fort Jesus ● Kilwa ● Great Zimbabwe ● is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Historical Sites and Monuments in Africa ● Fort Jesus ● Kilwa ● Great Zimbabwe ● as rumours only.
   B. Explain Historical Sites and Monuments in Africa ● Fort Jesus ● Kilwa ● Great Zimbabwe ● with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Historical Sites and Monuments in Africa ● Fort Jesus ● Kilwa ● Great Zimbabwe ●.
   D. Say Historical Sites and Monuments in Africa ● Fort Jesus ● Kilwa ● Great Zimbabwe ● never happens in Kenya.

12. Which statement about Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe.
   C. Explain Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe as rumours only.

13. Which statement about Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain.
   D. Treat Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain as rumours only.

14. Which statement about Map Reading and Interpretation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Map Reading and Interpretation.
   B. Say Map Reading and Interpretation never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Map Reading and Interpretation as rumours only.
   D. Explain Map Reading and Interpretation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

15. Which statement about Diversity and interpersonal skills is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Diversity and interpersonal skills.
   B. Explain Diversity and interpersonal skills with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Diversity and interpersonal skills as rumours only.
   D. Say Diversity and interpersonal skills never happens in Kenya.

16. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Explain symbols used on a map
   B. Name the president
   C. Replace the compass rose
   D. Measure rainfall only

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Citizenship and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Self- Improvement and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Self- Esteem Assessment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Scientific Theory about Human Origin and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Trans Saharan Slave Trade and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
